an4.177:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca :
an4.177:2.1: Yā ca Rāhula ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātū paṭhavīdhātur ev' esā.
an4.177:2.2: Taṃ n' etaṃ mama n' eso 'ham asmi na m' eso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ,
an4.177:2.3: evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindati paññāya cittaṃ virājeti. 2.
an4.177:3.1: Yā ca Rāhula ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu āpodhātur ev' esā.
an4.177:4.1: Yā ca Rāhula ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu tejodhātur ev' esā.
an4.177:5.1: Yā ca Rāhula ajjhattikā vāyodhāta yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu vāyodhātur ev' esā.
an4.177:5.2: Taṃ n' etaṃ mama n' eso 'ham asmi na m' eso atta ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ,
an4.177:5.3: evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ samappaññāya disvā vāyodhātuyā nibbindati paññāya cittaṃ virājeti. 5.
an4.177:6.1: Yato kho Rāhula bhikkhu imāsu catusu dhātūsu n' ev' attānaṃ nāttani yaṃ samanupassati, ayaṃ vuccati Rāhula bhikkhu acchecchi taṇhaṃ vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ sammā mānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassāti. 178. 1.
